messages.subject: Re: problem deploying app with mapview dependency on shinyapps.io server
parts:
Adding shinyapps-users

On Mon, Feb 27, 2017 at 6:16 AM John froeschke <john.fr...@gmail.com> wrote:
I am trying to update an existing shiny app (e.g., http://portal.gulfcouncil.org/coralhapc.html).  The app requires the 'mapview' package that works fine locally but creates an build error with 'rgdal' package (mapview dependency) when deploying.  I am using the development version of mapview as there seem to be limitations with the cran version.  

This package used:
install_github("environmentalinformatics-marburg/mapview", ref = "develop")




The follow error is printed in the deploy console

** preparing package for lazy loading
Error in dyn.load(file, DLLpath = DLLpath, ...) :
  unable to load shared object '/usr/local/lib/R/site-library/rgdal/libs/rgdal.so':
  libgdal.so.1: cannot open shared object file: No such file or directory
ERROR: lazy loading failed for package �mapview�
* removing �/usr/local/lib/R/site-library/mapview�
################################# End Task Log #################################
Error: Unhandled Exception: Child Task 349253751 failed: Error building image: Error building mapview (1.2.32). Build exited with non-zero status: 1
Execution halted


Below is a simple reproducible example that works locally but will not deploy.

#
# This is a Shiny web application. You can run the application by clicking
# the 'Run App' button above.
#
# Find out more about building applications with Shiny here:
#
#    http://shiny.rstudio.com/
#
if (!require('leaflet')) devtools::install_github('rstudio/leaflet')
if (!require('mapview')) devtools::install_github("environmentalinformatics-marburg/mapview", ref = "develop")


library(devtools)
library(shiny)
library(leaflet)
library(mapview)
# Define UI for application that draws a histogram
ui <- shinyUI(fluidPage(
   
 
      # Show a plot of the generated distribution
      mainPanel(
         leafletOutput("map")
      )
   )
)


# Define server logic required to draw a histogram
server <- shinyServer(function(input, output) {
   
   output$map <- renderLeaflet({
     map2 <- leaflet() %>%
       
       addTiles('http://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/World_Imagery/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}',
                options = providerTileOptions(noWrap = TRUE)) %>%
       addTiles('http://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/Reference/World_Boundaries_and_Places/Mapserver/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}',
                options = providerTileOptions(noWrap = TRUE)) %>%
       
       setView(-88.1, 27.75, zoom = 6) %>%
       addMouseCoordinates(style='basic')
   })
})




# Run the application
shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)

messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: problem deploying app with mapview dependency on shinyapps.io server
parts:
I believe that the sf and rgdal R packages are incompatible, since support for sf requires libgdal 2, which was added to the sf installer recently, while by default libgdal 1 is what is available.

An additional way to work around it might be by disabling the package cache for your application.

We will look into what it would take for both packages to be able to be installed together.

On Monday, February 27, 2017 at 2:27:03 PM UTC-5, John froeschke wrote:
As a temporary solution, I copied the functions I need from mapview into my global.r file and was able to deploy the app without loading the mapview library. 

On Monday, February 27, 2017 at 1:52:45 PM UTC-5, Joe Cheng [RStudio] wrote:
Adding shinyapps-users

On Mon, Feb 27, 2017 at 6:16 AM John froeschke <john.fr...@gmail.com> wrote:
I am trying to update an existing shiny app (e.g., http://portal.gulfcouncil.org/coralhapc.html).  The app requires the 'mapview' package that works fine locally but creates an build error with 'rgdal' package (mapview dependency) when deploying.  I am using the development version of mapview as there seem to be limitations with the cran version.  

This package used:
install_github("environmentalinformatics-marburg/mapview", ref = "develop")




The follow error is printed in the deploy console

** preparing package for lazy loading

Below is a simple reproducible example that works locally but will not deploy.

#
# This is a Shiny web application. You can run the application by clicking
# the 'Run App' button above.
#
# Find out more about building applications with Shiny here:
#
#    http://shiny.rstudio.com/
#
if (!require('leaflet')) devtools::install_github('rstudio/leaflet')
if (!require('mapview')) devtools::install_github("environmentalinformatics-marburg/mapview", ref = "develop")


library(devtools)
library(shiny)
library(leaflet)
library(mapview)
# Define UI for application that draws a histogram
ui <- shinyUI(fluidPage(
   
 
      # Show a plot of the generated distribution
      mainPanel(
         leafletOutput("map")
      )
   )
)


# Define server logic required to draw a histogram
server <- shinyServer(function(input, output) {
   
   output$map <- renderLeaflet({
     map2 <- leaflet() %>%
       
       addTiles('http://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/World_Imagery/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}',
                options = providerTileOptions(noWrap = TRUE)) %>%
       addTiles('http://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/Reference/World_Boundaries_and_Places/Mapserver/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}',
                options = providerTileOptions(noWrap = TRUE)) %>%
       
       setView(-88.1, 27.75, zoom = 6) %>%
       addMouseCoordinates(style='basic')
   })
})




# Run the application
shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
